description.value:
Despite being blessed by Nanook the Aeon and having the know-how of making a multitude of heavy weaponry, some members of the Antimatter Legion still prefer primitive non-firearms. The Voidrangers implant Antimatter Field Generators into their arms to form formidable Field Blades.

"Like a hot knife through butter."

D&D 5e Effect

As an action, consume this item and choose the creatures in your Main Party who can see you. The benefit begins when the next combat starts and lasts for 1 minute. For each affected creature, Strength increases by 1, maximum 20, and Crit Ratio increases by 1. A creature can benefit from only one synthesized pre-combat consumable at a time; a new one replaces the previous one.

GM Description — Original HSR Effect

Upon use, increases ATK of all allies by 260 and CRIT Rate by 8% for the next battle.
